summary: The discussion focused on refining filter syntax to support complex queries like keyframe scrubbing, logical operators (AND/OR), and exclusive value ranges. A significant update introduced the Track Selection Filter, which allows selecting top N tracks based on specific property values across a namespace, designed to improve scalability by running once at the relay ingress rather than per subscriber. The team clarified that while publishers can self-filter known properties, relays must aggregate and propagate all filter requests upstream to the original publisher to ensure accurate data delivery.
